thread:
maria: Hey @arch-team — quick checkpoint. PR #9087 is ready but gated on RFC-1983. Can someone confirm RFC covers the KV-cache routing fallback? RFC: https://redwood/repo/rfcs/1983. Also we need a canary plan: proposing 5% for 6h then 25% for 24h. Would like arch signoff to merge by tomorrow EOD. TL;DR below.

sam: Thanks — looking. maria can you paste a short TL;DR + main perf/regression numbers?

maria: TL;DR: adds a routing policy to prefer lighter-quant model on latency spikes; fallback to compatible variant with same weights. Perf: p95 +8% on synthetic long-seq without prefix cache, overall token cost -12% when batching is effective. Tests: e2e smoke + perf harness in PR.

archbot: RFC-1983 status: approved-by-arch=partial; awaiting author response on section 4.2 (cache invalidation details). Please attach updated diagram and note.

jordan: skimmed PR, left two inline comments about shard assignment. Not blocking if arch confirms fallback semantics.

devendra: If canary is 5% we should auto-rollback if error rate > 0.5%. PR currently has `auto_rollback: true` but threshold=1%.

maria: Good catch — updated PR to set threshold to 0.5%. PR: https://redwood/repo/pulls/9087

sam: Arch folks, can someone lgtm or ask for a quick call? Target merge tomorrow. @alex any bandwidth?

alex: I can take it. Need the updated diagram and a short note on how KV cache prefixes interact with the canary routing. If that lands in the PR I'll do arch OK.

maria: Added diagram + a note in the PR describing cache invalidation windows and how we shard prefixes for the canary. Also added e2e run id: `ci/1234`.

alex: Reviewing now.

alex: Arch note: approach looks reasonable. Concern: p95 regression on long sequences could impact chat routes. Recommend restricting initial canary to non-chat routes (embeddings & batch generation). Suggest 5% on those routes for 8h, then expand.

maria: We can gate by route. Updated canary plan in PR — route filter set to `/v1/embeddings` and `/v1/batch-gen` only.

alex: LGTM. arch-approve.

sam: :tada: Thanks everyone. Merging after CI passes. @ops please monitor metrics during rollout.

opsbot: Deploy scheduled for 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC — monitoring alert targets configured.

maria: Will monitor dashboards and post any anomalies here.

jordan: thumbs up
